description: The analytics module (stats.py) exposes mean() and median(). Two defects are reported. First, both functions raise an implementation-level error on an empty sequence instead of a ValueError with a clear message. Second, median() returns the upper middle element for even-length sequences instead of the average of the two middle elements. Fix both while keeping the functions pure.
expected_behavior: mean([]) and median([]) raise ValueError. median([1, 2, 3, 4]) == 2.5. Odd-length medians and normal means are unchanged.
notes: Synthetic defect seeded for the VerifyLoop benchmark. Not a production incident.
title: Statistics helpers fail on empty and even-length input
